t: Attempted Murder Of Zung Sih Eng

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE Sp. Br. REGISTRY No. N. 712 Date 17 3 / 41）
S. 1. Special Branch St/6661 File No. .................... Date March 15, 1941.
SUBJECT: Attempted murder of Zung Sih Eng
At about 8 a.m. yesterday, March 14, 1941, five male Chinese entered the home of Zung S'.. Eng (陳錫恩), located at No. 235 Rue Brenier de Montmorand, French Concession. Upon entering the premises, two of the intruders guarded the door to prevent the inmates from leaving, whilst the remaining three, one armed with a pistol and two with axes, attempted to proceed upstairs. They were, however, prevented from doing so by Chu Zung Zai (朱仁璇), son-in-law of Zung Sih Eng. One of the intruders then fired one shot at Chu, wounding him in the leg, whereupon the other two immediately proceeded upstairs, where, in the front room, they found Zung Sih Eng and chopped him four times on the head, causing severe injuries.
Having carried out their mission, the intruders, with the exception of the one armed with a pistol, who was grasped by Chu's wife, daughter of Zung Sih Eng, decamped and made good their escape before the arrival of the French Police.
Zung Sih Eng is 63 years of age and a native of Anhwei. He is member of the Dah (大) Character Class of the Green Fang. At present he is adviser to the Shanghai Dao Lee Relief Association 上海道里救濟協會, located at 8 Avenue Edward VII, and concurrently a member of the Board of Directors of the An Tsing League at Nanking (Wang's organization). He, together with his son-in-law, Chu Zung Zai, is
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 16 MAR. 1941）
Commr. of Police.

报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别支部 登记号 N. 712 日期 1941年3月17日）
S. 1. 特别支部 St/6661 档案号 .................... 日期 1941年3月15日。
主题：宗锡恩遇刺案
昨日，即1941年3月14日上午8时许，五名中国男子进入位于法租界蒙莫朗路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）235号的宗锡恩（陳錫恩）寓所。闯入者进入屋内后，其中两人把守门口以防屋内人员离开，其余三人中一人持手枪，两人持斧头，试图上楼。然而，宗锡恩的女婿朱仁璇（Chu Zung Zai）阻止了他们上楼。随后，一名闯入者向朱开枪，击中其腿部致其受伤，另外两人随即立即上楼，在前间找到宗锡恩，向其头部连砍四下，造成重伤。
行凶完毕后，除持手枪者被宗锡恩之女、即朱之妻抓住外，其余闯入者在法国巡捕到达之前逃之夭夭。
宗锡恩现年63岁，安徽籍人。他是青帮“大”字辈成员。目前担任位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）8号的上海道里救济协会顾问，并兼任南京安清同盟（汪伪组织）董事。他与其女婿朱仁璇正在
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1941年3月16日）
警务处处长。

情报
